cohort: 2021 mother-child dyads in the ECHO PATHWAYS consortium of prospective pregnancy cohorts (GAPPS, CANDLE, TIDES)
finding: Longer duration of exclusive breastfeeding had a protective association with child asthma.
mod_finding: For exclusive breastfeeding, protective associations with asthma outcomes were stronger in dyads with children born by vaginal vs cesarean delivery although interactions did not reach statistical significance
